name: Stage 55:1: Vagnhärad to Hungaskogen, etapp 55
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 55:1, Vagnhärad to Hungaskogen, etapp 55.
utilities: Official area: Nyköpings kommun, Trosa kommun.

Vagnhärad station is the current official start after the spring 2026 reroute and has strong train/bus access, parking, bicycle parking, EV charging, and nearby Vagnhärad town services. No current public toilet at the station itself was confirmed; the nearest mapped toilet is in Vagnhärad centrum near OKQ8/ICA.

The Hungaskogen/Stage 55 end is a trail junction rather than a transit endpoint. Continue on Stage 55 toward Trosa/Gisekvarn, backtrack to Vagnhärad, or use nearby local-road access only after live route planning.

Old Sillekrog start, Sillekrog parking, Granlund/Sillekrog bus access, and the 16-18 km Sillekrog-Hungaskogen descriptions are stale and should not be treated as current Stage 55:1 services. Naturkartan, OSM relation 8425612, AllTrails, Äventyrligare, and older PDFs/blogs may still expose the removed route.
waterSources: St Hunga spring is the only official water point on the current 55:1 connector, at the published coordinate near the Hunga end. It is an old natural cold spring; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee water quality, so treat/filter and carry backup.
No verified all-hours drinking-water tap was found at Vagnhärad station. Use town services if open, but do not rely on a station refill.
Dymossen shelter on Stage 55 has no water; if continuing from the 55:1 junction onto Stage 55, fill before committing to the longer dry section.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Spring 2026 reroute: Sörmlandsleden says the Sillekrog-Vagnhärad section has been removed and the new route is Vagnhärad station to the main trail. The same official page still contains stale Sillekrog fact-box/start-coordinate metadata, and it says the updated map is pending.

The app draws a provisional Vagnhärad station-to-Hungaskogen line from current official endpoints and the best available network geometry. The provisional line uses the station/parking approach around 58.945234, 17.488223, snaps to the remaining old connector corridor near 58.944563, 17.488386, and measures about 7.24 km to Hungaskogen, close to the official 7.2 km. Do not treat old Naturkartan, OSM relation 8425612, AllTrails, Äventyrligare, or blog geometry from Sillekrog as current.

Model this as an access connector to Stage 55, not as a normal mainline continuation. Once the user selects the relevant Hungaskogen/Trosabacken part of Stage 55, show 55:1 as the Vagnhärad-station access option.

Expect road/residential walking through Vagnhärad, a wetland/Trosaån edge, forest path, gravel road, farmland/farm-road sections, and forest/rural-road sections toward Hunga. User reports repeatedly mention wet/muddy forest sections after rain, especially near Hungaskogen and parts near Vagnhärad.

No shelter, campsite, or verified fireplace was found on the current 55:1 connector. Ordinary allemansrätten may apply away from homes/farmland/restricted areas, but local signs and fire bans override it.

No official reserve entry was verified for the current connector itself, but nearby Lånestaheden/Vagnhärad Runt side areas have stricter rules, including fire only at prepared places, no damaging trees/plants/deadwood, no motor vehicles, and dogs controlled/leashed in pasture/reserve contexts.

Trosa local rules matter near the start: dogs are leashed on public places, March 1-August 20 usually means leash/control in wildlife areas, dog bans apply at named beaches in summer, and camping on public-place-type areas is restricted to Trosa Havsbad/marked motorhome places. Check current fire-ban status before any stove/fire use.

A planned Hungavägen bus stop has been described locally as delayed/expected in spring 2026. Until it appears in current journey planners, use verified Vagnhärad station/Trosalands kyrka/Utterviksvägen-style options rather than assuming transit at Hungaskogen.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station current 55:1 start
facilities.description: Current official start after the spring 2026 reroute. Mälartåg, Sörmlandstrafiken buses, and Trosabussen connections serve the station; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station parking
facilities.description: Station parking area. Trosa municipality reports 24-hour parking in the main station area and longer parking on the gravel eastern part; verify current signs.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station bus bays
facilities.description: Station bus interchange. The 2025 terminal map lists lines 550, 551, 553, 554, 556, 605, 710, 802, 805, and Trosabussen; verify live departures.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station EV charging
facilities.description: Stationsparkeringen EV chargers. Trosa lists four outlets with a 12-hour daytime time limit; verify current signs/app status.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad station bike parking
facilities.description: Covered bicycle parking near the station, useful for bike-train access planning.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad centrum mapped toilet
facilities.description: OSM-mapped public toilet near Vagnhärad centrum, not independently confirmed as the official 55:1 dry toilet and not guaranteed to be directly on the current route.

facilities.name: ICA Supermarket Vagnhärad
facilities.description: Nearby town grocery/resupply option west of the station. Opening hours and customer services may change.

facilities.name: Willys Vagnhärad / Lånesta
facilities.description: Larger supermarket north of the station, useful as a resupply detour rather than a route-side stop. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Pizzeria Piccolino
facilities.description: Food option at/near Vagnhärad station. Verify opening hours.

facilities.name: Preem Vagnhärad
facilities.description: Fuel/kiosk/snack context close to the station. Opening and services can change.

facilities.name: Provisional station approach
facilities.description: Approximate connector area from Vagnhärad station/parking toward the remaining trail corridor. Public official map is pending; the app uses provisional geometry close to the 7.2 km official distance, so follow current orange markings on the ground.

facilities.name: Vagnhärad wetland / Trosaån rest context
facilities.description: Urban-edge wetland/Trosaån context from Trosa municipality and hiker reports near the Vagnhärad approach. Built wetland is about 2 ha and functions as water-polishing/nature habitat; treat as scenery/rest context, not an official facility.

facilities.name: 55:1 muddy forest warning
facilities.description: Hiker reports describe wet, muddy forest/path sections after rain and earlier small reroutes around private/fenced land. Follow current orange markings and expect sloppy footing.

facilities.name: Trosakorset bus access
facilities.description: Possible early-route or bailout bus context east of the station depending on final reroute geometry. Treat as access context until the official map is published.

facilities.name: Trosalands kyrka bus access
facilities.description: Road-218 bus stops near the eastern approach corridor. Verify live timetable and final route alignment; during road works, local notices have referred passengers toward Trosakorset-style replacement access.

facilities.name: St Hunga spring / kallkälla
facilities.description: Official Stage 55:1 water point near Stora Hunga. Natural spring water only; Sörmlandsleden does not test or guarantee water quality, so treat/filter and carry backup.

facilities.name: St Hunga / Hungaskogen dry-toilet caveat
facilities.description: Official facility icons indicate a dry toilet on 55:1, but no exact coordinate was verified in official map data or OSM. Do not plan around this toilet until member-map or field confirmation; pin is approximate at the spring.

facilities.name: Hungaskogen stage 55 junction
facilities.description: Current 55:1 access connector joins Stage 55 here. No direct transit at the junction; continue on Stage 55 toward Trosa/Gisekvarn or return to Vagnhärad.

facilities.name: Hunga access parking context
facilities.description: Nearby Hunga/Trosabacken/Vitalis access context with large gravel parking near the end of Friluftsvägen. Useful for the broader Hunga/Trosa recreation area, but not the official 55:1 endpoint.

facilities.name: Lånestaheden side-area reserve rules
facilities.description: Nearby Vagnhärad/Lånestaheden municipal nature reserve/Natura 2000 side area, not the confirmed 55:1 route. Reserve rules include no motor vehicles, no open fire except prepared places, no damaging vegetation/deadwood, and dog control/leash requirements in pasture/reserve context.

facilities.name: Stale 55:1 map-data warning
facilities.description: Naturkartan site 13905, OSM relation 8425612, AllTrails, Äventyrligare, and similar derived maps may still show the removed 16-18 km Sillekrog-Hungaskogen route; OSM relation 8425612 still measured about 17.88 km in review. Current official route is Vagnhärad-Hungaskogen, 7.2 km, with official map pending.

facilities.name: Old Sillekrog route removed in 2026
